superseded_preliminary_result.reason: The preliminary review used the earlier global/cross-platform release scope. The user subsequently excluded macOS/POSIX and real Claude/Codex lifecycle gates and explicitly waived the 250k p95 gate for this Windows/OpenCode acceptance.

verified_findings.detail: Remote repeat stability requires maximum absolute delta <= 5e-4 and cosine >= 0.99999. Positive and negative policy tests passed; the final focused verifier run passed 30 tests.

The selected openai/BAAI/bge-m3 model returned dimension 1024 with semantic margin 0.509570186307466, repeat delta 0.00015527625986305749, repeat cosine 0.9999993678186736, batch delta 0.0 and batch cosine approximately 1.0.

SQLite used DELETE journaling with header 1/1, integrity ok, append-only triggers and restart readback. Two provider calls produced two bound claims and two completed terminal receipts, with zero recoveries and zero unbound records.
Windows-native ACL/link checks, journal/outbox contention, safe SQLite fallback and single-writer behavior passed the scoped validation.
No API key, bearer value, URL credential or JWT trace was found in the durable evidence. The harness resolves the credential from the environment and clears it in a finally block.

After the final authority synchronization, current-6 wheel and sdist passed supplied Python 3.14 smoke evidence. Independent archive, manifest-binding and source-equivalence verification is recorded by the same verifier.

explicit_waivers_and_exclusions: The 250,000-record retrieval p95 target is waived for this acceptance.
macOS/POSIX-only tests are excluded and are not relabeled as passes.
Real Claude and Codex lifecycle tests are outside the OpenCode-only scope and are not relabeled as passes.
Qwen3 and e5-mistral remain quarantined; this acceptance applies only to the selected BGE-M3 model.
